prompts: Words are tied to each other, and nobody here can see how. {WS}/site is a saved copy of a Portuguese creative dictionary. Explore this universe of words: collect what the site knows and build {WS}/universe/index.html, a single file that sums the universe up in one view and lets someone search for a word and find how it relates to others. The best way to show it is your call, and that view is what we care about most. So people can share a word, opening the page with ?word=saudade must show that word and its relations. Save the data as {WS}/words.json, mapping each word to the words it is linked to, and record in {WS}/result.json: words (how many), relations (how many distinct pairs) and most_connected. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
Done. My tab is closed; the remaining tabs belong to other workspaces, not this session.

[goal] Extract the word graph from the saved PT dictionary in ./site and ship a single-file searchable universe view.

[action] Parsed all 262 HTML pages with a Python script: kept the 250 word pages (header/aside/footer links ignored, only the `sinonimos`/`analogas` sections inside `<main>` count), resolved the three meta-refresh plural stubs (corações→coração, paixões→paixão, saudades→saudade), and mapped hrefs (percent-decoded, case-insensitive filenames) to canonical words from each page's `<h1>`. Built `words.json` (word → published links) and `result.json`, precomputed a deterministic 3D Fruchterman–Reingold layout, and embedded all data inline in `universe/index.html` (fetch of words.json is blocked under file://, so the page is self-contained; only Google Fonts and the allowed three.js CDN are external).

[result]
- `words.json`: 250 words → linked words; `result.json`: `{"words": 250, "relations": 743, "most_connected": "palavra"}`.
- `universe/index.html`: a 3D constellation (three.js) — nodes sized by degree, colored by the site's 11 temas with a legend; drag-orbit, zoom, click a star or a relation chip to travel; search box with autocomplete, accent/case-insensitive; `?word=saudade` preselects and highlights that word's relations and updates the URL on every selection.
- Assumptions: relations are undirected distinct pairs (the site is not fully symmetric — 151 of 743 pairs are published one-way only, so the view shows the union of both directions); `most_connected` is by distinct-relation degree, where `palavra` and `tempo` tie at 16, reported alphabetically first.

[verification] Live in a real browser at file://: `?word=saudade` showed the panel "saudade · sentimentos · 5 relações (ansiedade, carinho, dor, esperança, nostalgia)" matching the union computed from words.json; `?word=AMOR` resolved to amor with its 6 relations; typing "AVO" + Enter selected "avô" and rewrote the URL to `?word=av%C3%B4`; a relation-chip click navigated avô→avó. During testing I caught and fixed a real bug: my first edge-dedup dropped the 151 one-direction pairs from the rendered lines. Counts are cross-checked two ways (743 unique pairs = 2×592 mutual + 151 one-way, and the page's own header agrees).

[next] Nothing pending; the three artifacts are final.
